data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘webban,’ meaning ‘to weave.’ In biblical times, webs were often used as symbols of God’s protection, as seen in the story of Noah’s Ark. The name Web can also symbolize the interconnectedness of all things, and the idea that God is the ultimate weaver of our lives. The name Web carries the meaning “Network, connection” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Web usually hope their child will grow to embody network, connection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
